name: Auth mechanisms
description: Tests every supported auth type (none, bearer, basic, apikey, digest, ntlm, oauth2) against the local mock server.

req-none.name: None (no auth)
req-none.postRequestScript:
sp.test('status is 200', function () { sp.expect(sp.response.code).to.equal(200); });
sp.test('server reports authenticated', function () { sp.expect(sp.response.json().authenticated).to.equal(true); });
